result.reason: The clause includes the preferred safeguards: one audit per 12 months, 30 days’ written notice, business-hours conduct, an independent confidentiality-bound auditor, Vendor-paid costs unless underpayment exceeds 5%, and no direct systems access. It is not minimal because it additionally requires self-certification using Vendor telemetry, permits an auditor only if that process is reasonably inconclusive, excludes Customer competitors, and prohibits direct facilities access. Those additions go beyond the playbook, though they remain related to audit procedure and do not disturb unrelated commercial terms. The drafting is generally professional, with some unnecessary complexity and duplication between Sections 22.1 and 22.2.
